When Carrie and Arthur's constant bickering begins to spiral out of control, Doug and Carrie decide it's time to send Arthur to a psychotherapist (guest star William Hurt) to find the root of his anger.

Doug takes $100 from his and Carrie's savings stash to bet on boxing. When he and Deacon win $5,000, they hide the winnings from their wives by blowing the entire amount in one day, which includes having singer Eddie Money give them a private concert.
When Doug has a bad toothache and winds up needing root canal, he finds out that Carrie used to have a crush on his dentist, Dr. Farber (Tim Matheson).
After their neighbors hear Doug & Carrie in a big fight, Carrie tries to convince the neighbors, Mike and Debi that they are better than that; Arthur gets Spence to let him ride the subway for free.
